title: Doty's rival version: 1964 at White Sands

tellings.quote: So Bob told me absolutely it was May of 1971 and then Richard Dodie comes up and says no no no it was it was 64 at White Sands and they got lost.

related.note: Doty gives a rival account of the same landing told in #7, putting it at White Sands in 1964 with the beings having gotten lost, against Emenegger's May 1971 at Holloman.

plain: A landing that some say was caught on film at a New Mexico air base happened in May 1971, by one account. A former Air Force man named Richard Doty says it was really 1964, at White Sands, a military test range in New Mexico, and that "they got lost." The researcher Grant Cameron tells this second-hand: he says a filmmaker named Bob Emenegger told him it was "absolutely" May 1971, and then Doty came along saying "no no no." The date matters because it decides which event, and which piece of film, people are actually talking about.
